Many viewers liked the expanded focus on supporting characters and felt the new apprentice dynamic was promising.
The children’s interactions and Maomao’s increasingly nurturing role were repeatedly described as endearing.

Some discussion expressed curiosity about the broader conflict and praised the direction of the story, but also suggested that the episode raised more questions than it answered.
